usage: Fuel for tools/direct.py + skills/ideate. Hooks and wild cards are PROMPTS to think from, not presets to copy. Blacklist is enforced by the ideate pass before concepts are shown.

hook_bank.idea: Black frame, one diegetic sound 0.4s, then the visual answers it mid-motion.
Open at 70% of the action, rewind 1s to explain — momentum first, context second.
Extreme macro on a texture (bean surface, thread fiber, concrete pore) that pulls back to reveal context.
Open on a stat framed as false, let motion prove it true or expose the twist.
Physical hand/scissor/brush performs every transition as the film's grammar.
Everything assembles backwards; the 'reveal' is order emerging from scatter.
One Arabic sentence occupies frame alone; the drama is purely its internal timing per-word.
Tidy editorial grid progressively breaks as the argument gets bold.
Two claims race in split RTL/LTR columns; the winner takes the full frame.
A ticker/badges/labels animate as UI lies people accept, then strip them off.
Hold 1.5s on one perfect poster frame before anything moves — confidence as hook.
'You are here' literal: camera is the viewer's route through the data-space.

wild_cards.seed: lower-third AR overlays riding real footage with ball-tracking energy
tiny precise typography + enormous negative space as the flex
cuts on timbre change, not beat
skeuomorphic feedback (bounce, tick, haptic-flash) at film scale
audio-reactive geometry with hard limiters — reactive, never wobbling
imperfect ink weight as the anti-CAD signature
camera cuts the world in half to explain depth
the product photo is the hero type; type is the label

cliche_blacklist: fade-in headline on blurred bokeh background
underline sweep + fade as the only text animation
infinite white-background product rotation with soft shadow
same easing on entrance and exit for every layer
stock whoosh sound on every single cut
trend_questions_2026: editorial-collage revival: what did motion designers DO with paper/cut texture this year that wasn't done in 2023?
AI-assisted frames as background layers — what remains the human craft signal?
kinetic Arabic: which studios are setting the word-reveal bar right now, by what technique?
vertical-first cinema crops: what safe-margin grammar won?
audio-reactive restrained (one channel bound), where is it overused?
quality_bar: A concept is bold when: it survives the blacklist, has a nameable signature move, reads muted at phone size, and the first frame is designed — not generated.
